category.name: Device code phishing
category.short: Lures that trick victims into signing the attacker in with a device code
category.summary: The victim is sent to Microsoft's (or another provider's) real device-login page and asked to type a short code. Entering it signs the attacker's device in as the victim, with no password stolen and no MFA prompt the victim can refuse, because the victim completes MFA themselves.
